liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Gloria Jam** (3 reviews): The He's Gone, Gloria Jam and CC Rider sequence is singled out as the show's highlight; He's Gone into Gloria Jam, CC Rider and the following jam is a must-listen [20][23][26]
- **Not Fade Away** (2 reviews): Reviewer says the whole Not Fade Away sizzles; Reviewer was hooked by the Not Fade Away intro, replaying it repeatedly after hearing a copy around 1981 [24][25]
- **Black Peter** (2 reviews): Black Peter is a personal favorite, with a very good extended solo; Reviewer says they sang lead vocals along with Jerry on Black Peter, and it rocked [20][24]
- **Sugaree** (1 review): Jack Straw is cut, then runs into a roughly 17-minute Sugaree [18]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 review): Reviewer names this China Cat into I Know You Rider as their favorite version from any era [15]
- **Looks Like Rain** (1 review): Looks Like Rain has a nice intro featuring thunder-like drums [23]

## Setlist highlights

- **Gloria Jam**: mythic rare: 2 archived performances [27]
- Earliest performances in the archive: C C Rider [27]

## The recordings

- **gd1979-12-01.sick-bits-15.matrix.chappell.31946.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 25 songs; 221 min; rated 4.25/5 by 4 [1]
- **gd1979-12-01.dts.haugh.34294.flac**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 24 songs; 215 min [2]. Said about its sound: Front-of-board audience source is excellent for 1979; soundboard is balanced with everyone in the mix; Slight phase appears mostly in the first set; first set runs a little slow, second set soundboard is in pitch [2]
- **gd1979-12-01.sbd.miller.96408.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 21 songs; 177 min; rated 4.55/5 by 22 [5]
- **gd79-12-01.sbd.miller.29429.sbeok.flacf**: soundboard; 21 songs; 178 min; rated 4.42/5 by 12 [6]
- **gd79-12-01.sbd.barbella.6022.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 20 songs; 175 min; rated 4.2/5 by 15 [9]. Said about its sound: Soundboard quality is good, with a laid-back, mellow groove typical of the period; First set sounds terrific on this source, though it has a few abrupt cuts; Second set on this copy is quiet and muffled, missing highs; reviewer recommends the other soundboard source [15][18]
- **gd79-12-01.sbd.set2.clugston.319.sbefail.shnf**: soundboard; 12 songs; 106 min; rated 4.58/5 by 24 [14]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls the sound of this second-set download excellent [22]

## Around the show

- Bob's guitar has a distinctive steely tone in 1979, and Brent is still learning the ropes [22]
- Reviewer calls the show a jammer rather than a rocker; Brent doesn't play like a rookie [23]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1979-12-01.sick-bits-15.matrix.chappell.31946.flac16**: taped by See info files for details; transferred by Chris Chappell; source: Soundboard and Audience Matrix (see info file) [1]
- **gd1979-12-01.dts.haugh.34294.flac**: taped by See info files for details; transferred by Dan Haugh; source: Soundboard and Audience Matrix (see info file) [2]. Also: Uploader worked with Am-Dig on a matrix and 5.1 mix combining the audience and soundboard sources [2]
- **gd1979-12-01.sbd.miller.96408.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (Sony TCD5M/UDXL-II) -> Dat (Panasonic SV3800/48k) [5]. Also: Source chain is unknown mics to cassette master to CD; Me And My Uncle's opening seven minutes come from it; This is a re-master of an earlier release, with pitch correction help from Joe B. Jones [5]
- **gd79-12-01.sbd.miller.29429.sbeok.flacf**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Soundboard [6]. Also: Soundboard to cassette master on Sony TCD5M with UDXL-II tape, then to Panasonic DAT; transferred and edited by Charlie Miller [6]
- **gd79-12-01.sbd.barbella.6022.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [9]
- **gd79-12-01.sbd.set2.clugston.319.sbefail.shnf**: source: Soundboard [14]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by LiveGRATEFUL.net: [Grateful Dead 1979-12-01 Sat Stanley Theatre, Pittsburgh, PA](https://www.livegrateful.net/post/1022260390927/december-1-1979-stanley-theater) [28]
